summary: Tested CRM Contracts Management System for iteration 114. All 24 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Contracts list with stats row, search, filters, create modal, contract detail with 8 tabs (Overview, Sites, Assets, SLA & Coverage, Service Integration, Billing, Approvals, Timeline), Add Site/Asset dialogs, Edit SLA form, Sync to Sicon/Sage buttons (MOCKED), Edit/Renew buttons for active contracts.

backend_01_get_contract_tiers.details: GET /api/crm/v2/contracts/tiers returns 6 tiers (warranty, bronze, silver, gold, platinum, bespoke)

backend_03_get_contract_stats.details: GET /api/crm/v2/contracts/stats returns total, active, draft, pending_approval, expiring_soon, active_annual_value

backend_04_check_coverage_endpoint.details: GET /api/crm/v2/contracts/check-coverage returns has_coverage, contracts, best_tier, sla

backend_05_list_contracts.details: GET /api/crm/v2/contracts returns contracts array with total count

backend_06_create_contract.details: POST /api/crm/v2/contracts creates contract with id, contract_number, status=draft

backend_07_get_contract_detail.details: GET /api/crm/v2/contracts/{id} returns full detail with sites, covered_assets, activities

backend_09_delete_draft_contract.details: DELETE /api/crm/v2/contracts/{id} deletes draft contract, returns 404 on re-fetch

backend_10_add_site_to_contract.details: POST /api/crm/v2/contracts/{id}/sites adds site with site_name, address, city, postcode

backend_12_add_asset_to_contract.details: POST /api/crm/v2/contracts/{id}/assets adds asset with asset_name, model_code, serial_number, coverage_type

backend_14_update_contract_sla.details: PUT /api/crm/v2/contracts/{id}/sla updates response_hours, resolution_hours, parts_included, labour_included

backend_16_approve_contract.details: POST /api/crm/v2/contracts/{id}/approve with decision=approved changes status to approved

backend_17_reject_contract.details: POST /api/crm/v2/contracts/{id}/approve with decision=rejected returns status to draft

backend_22_renew_contract.details: POST /api/crm/v2/contracts/{id}/renew creates new draft contract and renewal opportunity

frontend_01_contracts_list.details: Contracts list page loads with header, stats row, search, filters, contract rows

frontend_02_stats_row.details: Stats row shows Total, Active, Draft, Pending Approval, Expiring Soon, Active Value

frontend_04_status_filters.details: Filter buttons: All, Active, Draft, Pending Approval, Approved, Expiring, Expired

frontend_05_create_contract_modal.details: New Contract modal with title, company, contact, tier, type, value, billing, dates

frontend_06_contract_detail_8_tabs.details: Contract detail page has 8 tabs: Overview, Sites, Assets, SLA & Coverage, Service Integration, Billing, Approvals, Timeline

frontend_07_add_site_dialog.details: Add Site dialog with site_name, address, city, postcode, notes fields

frontend_08_add_asset_dialog.details: Add Covered Asset dialog with asset_name, model_code, serial_number, coverage_type, warranty_end, exclusions

frontend_09_edit_sla_form.details: Edit SLA inline form with response_hours, resolution_hours, parts_included, labour_included, visits_per_year, preventive_maintenance

frontend_10_service_integration_tab.details: Service Integration tab shows Sicon and Sage 200 cards with Push/Re-sync buttons

frontend_11_action_buttons.details: Edit button always visible, Renew for active contracts, Delete for non-active, Sign for approved

critical_code_review_comments: Code review passed - Contracts Management System implementation is complete and functional
All CRUD operations work correctly with proper status transitions
Approval workflow (submit -> approve/reject) works as expected
Sicon and Sage 200 syncs are MOCKED - return fake reference IDs
